name: product-squad
description: Agentic dev OS for one-person teams: a product/scoping cluster (mission → why → vet → shape → experience → owit → elon → spec) + a visual fidelity ladder (sketch → wireframe → mockup → prototype → handoff), bridged by /decompose and shipped via /gh-issue + 4 swappable brand-archetype flavors (linear, apple, airbnb, uber). Plus 37 command skills: UI audits (a11y, brand-audit, crap, imagine, qa, ux-design), harness/context audits (harness-audit, context-diet, usage-audit), eng tighteners (architecture, build, eng-deep-dive, eng-review, investigate, pm, refactor, verify, ship, pr-review), spec contracts (flow, api), brand & naming (namer, domain-check), product (mochary, simplify, grill), agentic patterns (agent-question), safety (guard), and session hygiene (getting-started, checkpoint, debrief, list-capabilities, pickup, retro, sessions, sync-repos, todo). Plus 8 optional example/integration-template skills (notification-setup, dns-setup, deploy-status, deploy-trigger, analytics-setup, weekly-review, worktree-cleanup, ship-ready-check) — each demonstrates a transferable pattern using one concrete provider (AWS SES, Cloudflare, Railway, PostHog) as the worked example; install on demand and swap the provider.
